package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for raw_db_error_exposed_to_client: Direct serialization of SQL or GORM error text into API responses.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type Service struct {
	DB *sql.DB
}

func (s *Service) GetUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := r.URL.Query().Get("id")
	row := s.DB.QueryRowContext(r.Context(), "SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = $1", id)

	var name string
	err := row.Scan(&name)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Write([]byte(name))
}
